originals.section: ### P0-1 — Integrationsautorität muss vor teurer Umsetzung funktionieren

clauses.content: Generator runner/model path, unsupported flag, delivery/requester readiness, full smoke through reviewer admission, real identity conflict negative.

originals.section: ### P0-2 — Veröffentlichungsautorität und Qualitätsqualifikation sind entkoppelt

clauses.content: Push authority separate from candidate quality, required independent review/Verify lineage and transparent exception route.

originals.section: ### P0-3 — Result, Paket und Abschluss müssen transaktional konsistent bleiben

clauses.content: Result writer/continuity/package hash consistency, missing reconcile fence, actual package validator in close/Verify, journal/postimage and signed repair roundtrip.

originals.section: ### P1-1 — Ein nutzbarer Read-only- und Forensikpfad fehlt

clauses.content: Harmless cat/ls/rg-g and structured Read/Glob/Grep, truthful missing versus denied errors, external/symlink/credential/restart cross-runner controls.
Narrow transcript export and real host identity conflict/completeness.

originals.section: ### P1-2 — Prüfartefakte dürfen einander nicht überschreiben

clauses.content: Schema-separated screenshot/function paths, atomic output, immutable run index/hash/viewport/latest pointer and preserving existing evidence.

originals.section: ### P1-3 — Vorabvalidierung und persistierte Eingaben statt PO-Recovery

clauses.content: HEAD/first commit, criterion schema/rendering, review-source closure before submission mutation; persist prior identity/mode/commit answers.

originals.section: ### P1-4 — Tatsächliche Architekturprüfung braucht eine wirksame Disposition

clauses.content: Disposition of ownership findings and unavailable classes; conformance semantics agree with report-only observations.

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 2

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 3

Greenfield materialize-architecture instead of destructive false adoption course.

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 5

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 6

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 7

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 8

originals.section: §2 numbered finding 11

originals.section: ### P0-1 (Kritischer Produktdefekt): Antigravity PreToolUse-Hook überwacht weder `write_file` noch `edit_file` noch `read_file`

clauses.content: Plugin and installer user-level hook matcher, native write_file/edit_file/read_file mapping and exact arguments; role/test protection and bootstrap read visibility, post-close writes.

originals.section: ### P0-2 (Kritischer Produktdefekt): Subagent-Dispatch (`invoke_subagent`) scheitert in Antigravity systematisch an `DISPATCH-MODEL-MISSING` / Modell-Enum-Konflikt

clauses.content: Runner-specific Model enum/routing and no silent inheritance.
Draft/implementing sanctioned prepare/model-role-bootstrap/design-review-receipt paths and argument admission.

originals.section: ### P1-1 (Produktdefekt / Sicherheitslücke im Lifecycle): `submit-plan` und `close-coordinator` akzeptieren selbst-erstellte Design-Receipts und schließen Features ohne Ausführungs-Critic ab

clauses.content: Submit-plan rejects self-authored design receipt without actual independent dispatch custody.
Push/close/close-feature require actual post-implementation candidate-bound execution Critic even when no course record already exists.

originals.section: ### P1-2 (UX- & Operator-Friktion): Mehrstufige Signatur-Kommandos im Terminal brechen bei Zeilenumbruch und Plugin-Update

clauses.content: One wrap-safe signing command, no second PO apply command, agent imports proof.
Agent may apply authentic PO plan proof while preserving anti-self-approval.
Background runner-view update preserves active hook cwd, stable wrapper/view lifetime.
